caption: The drawing depicts a ceramic bowl with a wide, open mouth and a small cylindrical structure rising from the center of its interior base. The exterior of the bowl is a uniform brown color, suggestive of unglazed or lightly glazed clay. The interior features a series of concentric rings in shades of yellow, green, and brown, with a wavy black line encircling the bowl, just above the central structure. The overall composition is focused on the bowl, which is centered on a plain, light beige background. The bowl exhibits shading and highlights that give it a realistic, three-dimensional appearance.
title: Economite Bowl or Cake Mold
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
